rationale: The response delivers full-throated, indignant self-defense with total confidence, reframing the allegation as MORE American ('I was present at my seat through the conclusion of the third quarter'), invokes rights ('freedom of assembly'), and stays in the hearing-room register throughout.
quote: I categorically deny these scurrilous allegations. I am not now, nor have I ever been, a member of the 'Beat Traffic' movement.
